description: Function-valued cell and header templates on top of createPivotModel in Svelte 5. Value cells render traffic-light pills for revenue against target, data bars for units and signed arrows for variance, chosen by reading the measure id off the column id; header cells add a measure icon, a units label and a target-line annotation under each quarter; and the row-header cell shows a coloured region chip, depth-based indent and an expand chevron. The pivot engine is unchanged.

faq.question: How does a value cell know which measure it shows?
faq.answer: The pivot engine encodes the column axis path and the measure id in each leaf column id; the cell function decodes it and picks the pill, bar or arrow renderer accordingly.

faq.question: Can header cells be customised too?
faq.answer: Yes. The header option accepts a function receiving the column, so the demo adds an icon and a units label to measure headers and an annotation to the quarter group headers.

faq.question: Does styling affect the totals?
faq.answer: No. Subtotal and grand-total rows come from the engine as before; the renderers only change how the emitted values are drawn.
